newsitem.title: CANADA: Ontario revises 96/97 deficit to C$7.67 billion.
newsitem.headline: Ontario revises 96/97 deficit to C$7.67 billion.

text.p: Ontario Finance Minister Ernie Eves said on Thursday the province's deficit outlook has been cut to C$7.67 billion in fiscal 1996/97, down C$501 million from the government's estimate in the previous second quarter.
Eves said Ontario's revenue outlook for the year has been revised up to C$47.8 billion, up C$1.1 billion from the estimate reported in the previous second quarter.

"The (revenue) increase is primarily due to higher than estimated personal income tax revenue and the strength of the Ontario economy," Eves said in his fiscal update for the third quarter ended December 31, 1996.
Eves said the government's budget reserve is maintained at C$650 million dollars.
